title: ZenBook Air 14
description: Ultra-light 14-inch aluminium laptop built for people who work on the move. Fanless under light load and thin enough to disappear into a backpack.

reviews.author: Marta R.
reviews.title: Perfect travel laptop
reviews.body: I fly twice a month and this is the first laptop I stopped noticing in my bag. Battery life is genuinely all day — I got about eleven hours of writing and browsing on a transatlantic flight without charging.

reviews.author: Dev P.
reviews.title: Great screen, warm under load
reviews.body: The OLED panel is gorgeous for photo work. It does get warm on the underside when I compile for a while, so it is not a lap machine when working hard.

reviews.author: Ingrid L.
reviews.title: Light enough to forget
reviews.body: Weight is the whole story here. 1.1 kg means I carry it everywhere. Keyboard is shallow but comfortable enough for long sessions.

title: ProBook 15 Developer Edition
description: Fifteen-inch developer workstation with a 45W processor, 32 GB of memory and Linux preinstalled. Built for compiling, containers, and running local databases.

reviews.author: Sam K.
reviews.title: Compiles fast, Linux just works
reviews.body: Every piece of hardware worked on Ubuntu out of the box, which is rare. Docker builds that took four minutes on my old machine take ninety seconds.

reviews.author: Rae M.
reviews.title: Heavy but worth it
reviews.body: It is not a travel machine at 1.8 kg and the battery drains quickly under a full build. As a desk machine it is excellent.

reviews.author: Tom V.
reviews.title: Fans are loud
reviews.body: My only real complaint is fan noise under sustained load. In a quiet room it is very noticeable.

title: MacBook Air M3 13
description: Silent, fanless 13-inch laptop with exceptional battery life and a high-quality display. The default choice for general-purpose work.

reviews.author: Priya N.
reviews.title: Battery life is unreal
reviews.body: Two full working days between charges. I stopped carrying the charger to the office entirely.

reviews.author: Owen B.
reviews.title: Completely silent
reviews.body: No fan means no noise, ever. After years of whining laptop fans this alone was worth the upgrade.

reviews.author: Lila F.
reviews.title: Only two ports
reviews.body: Wonderful machine, but two USB-C ports and nothing else means living with a dongle.

title: Nitro Gaming 16
description: Sixteen-inch gaming laptop with a discrete GPU and a 165 Hz display. Also capable as a machine-learning workstation for local model experimentation.

reviews.author: Kenji A.
reviews.title: Fast, but plan for the charger
reviews.body: Performance is excellent and it trains small models locally without complaint. Battery life away from power is under two hours, so treat it as a portable desktop.

reviews.author: Nina S.
reviews.title: Loud fans, great value
reviews.body: The fans are aggressive. Ear defenders or headphones are basically mandatory during long sessions.

title: Chromebook Go 12
description: Budget twelve-inch laptop for browsing, documents, and video calls. Rugged plastic shell designed for students.

reviews.author: Hugo T.
reviews.title: Does what it says
reviews.body: Cheap, light, and the battery lasts the whole school day. Do not expect it to handle anything heavy.

reviews.author: Beth C.
reviews.title: Screen is dim
reviews.body: Works fine indoors but the display is too dim to use outside or near a bright window.

title: Studio Laptop 17
description: Seventeen-inch colour-accurate laptop for video editors and designers, with a factory-calibrated display and a full-size card reader.

reviews.author: Sofia D.
reviews.title: Colour accuracy out of the box
reviews.body: I checked it against my calibrated monitor and the difference was negligible. Saves me a step on every job.

reviews.author: Marc J.
reviews.title: Enormous
reviews.body: It is a desk machine that happens to fold. Do not buy this expecting to use it on a train.

title: ErgoSplit Pro Mechanical
description: Split ergonomic mechanical keyboard with tenting and a concave key well, designed to reduce wrist strain during long typing sessions. Popular with programmers who type all day.

reviews.author: Alex W.
reviews.title: Fixed my wrist pain
reviews.body: Six months of RSI and two weeks with this keyboard and the pain is gone. The split and tenting mean my forearms stay straight all day.

reviews.author: Jo H.
reviews.title: Steep learning curve
reviews.body: Took me a solid three weeks to get back to full typing speed. Worth it, but budget for the adjustment period.

reviews.author: Cam O.
reviews.title: Programmable layers are the point
reviews.body: Being able to put symbols on a layer under my home row changed how I write code. No more reaching for brackets.

title: TypeMaster 87 TKL
description: Tenkeyless mechanical keyboard with hot-swappable switches and wireless connectivity. A comfortable, affordable entry into mechanical keyboards for developers.

reviews.author: Dana E.
reviews.title: Best value for programmers
reviews.body: Hot-swap sockets mean I could try three switch types without buying three keyboards. Comfortable for eight-hour days.

reviews.author: Ravi S.
reviews.title: Bluetooth drops occasionally
reviews.body: Great keyboard wired. Over Bluetooth it disconnects maybe once a week and needs re-pairing.

reviews.author: Ellie G.
reviews.title: Quiet enough for the office
reviews.body: With the linear switches and the included dampeners nobody around me complains.

title: Compact 60 Wireless
description: Sixty-percent wireless keyboard that saves desk space and travels well. Low-profile scissor switches keep the height down.

reviews.author: Yuki M.
reviews.title: Great for travel
reviews.body: Fits in the laptop sleeve pocket. I take it on every trip so I am not stuck on a laptop keyboard.

reviews.author: Peter L.
reviews.title: Miss the arrow keys
reviews.body: The 60% layout means arrows live on a function layer. Fine for typing, frustrating for spreadsheets.

title: SilentTouch Office
description: Quiet membrane keyboard with a padded wrist rest, intended for shared offices where noise matters.

reviews.author: Grace P.
reviews.title: Genuinely silent
reviews.body: You can type through a meeting on video and nobody hears it.

reviews.author: Ian R.
reviews.title: Wrist rest is the best part
reviews.body: The keyboard is unremarkable. The wrist rest is unexpectedly good and I would miss it now.

title: Mech Pro Programmer 75
description: Seventy-five-percent mechanical keyboard balancing a compact footprint with dedicated arrow keys and a function row. Built for developers who want ergonomics without a split layout.

reviews.author: Nadia K.
reviews.title: The right compromise
reviews.body: Arrow keys and a function row in a compact body. This is the layout I wish every keyboard used.

reviews.author: Felix B.
reviews.title: Build quality is superb
reviews.body: Zero flex, tight tolerances. It feels like it will outlast the computer it is plugged into.

title: WH-1000 Noise Cancelling
description: Over-ear active noise cancelling headphones tuned for long flights and open-plan offices. Thirty-hour battery and a folding travel case.

reviews.author: Claire V.
reviews.title: Made long flights bearable
reviews.body: The noise cancelling removes engine drone completely. I arrived off a nine-hour flight actually rested for once.

reviews.author: Diego F.
reviews.title: Battery life is excellent
reviews.body: I charge them roughly once a week with daily commuting use. Thirty hours is not a marketing number.

reviews.author: Anya T.
reviews.title: Warm ears after a few hours
reviews.body: Superb sound and isolation, but the earcups get hot after about three hours of continuous wear.

title: QuietComfort Ultra
description: Premium comfort-focused noise cancelling headphones with a lightweight clamp designed for all-day wear.

reviews.author: Robin H.
reviews.title: The most comfortable I have owned
reviews.body: I wear them for six hours straight without noticing. Nothing else I have tried comes close on comfort.

reviews.author: Mei L.
reviews.title: Battery is the weak point
reviews.body: Fantastic in every way except battery — 24 hours is fine, but competitors do 30 and I notice on long trips.

title: Studio Monitor Reference 80
description: Open-back reference headphones for mixing and critical listening. Flat frequency response with a wide soundstage.

reviews.author: Ola N.
reviews.title: Honest sound
reviews.body: They tell you the truth about your mix, which is not always flattering but is the entire point.

reviews.author: Sanjay R.
reviews.title: Zero isolation, by design
reviews.body: Open-back means everyone hears your music and you hear the room. Studio use only — useless on a train.

title: SportBuds Active
description: Sweat-resistant wireless earbuds with a secure fit for running and gym use. Compact charging case.

reviews.author: Tess A.
reviews.title: They stay put
reviews.body: Ran a half marathon in the rain and neither bud shifted. That is all I ask for.

reviews.author: Luca M.
reviews.title: Battery life could be better
reviews.body: Eight hours per charge is fine for workouts but I would not fly with them as my only pair.

reviews.author: Ben Q.
reviews.title: Muddy bass
reviews.body: The fit and durability are great. The sound quality is clearly a step below wired options at this price.

title: AirPods Pro 3
description: Compact noise cancelling earbuds with transparency mode and seamless switching between devices.

reviews.author: Jess W.
reviews.title: Switching between devices is seamless
reviews.body: They follow me from laptop to phone without a thought. That convenience is why I keep buying them.

reviews.author: Karl D.
reviews.title: Great for travel, short battery
reviews.body: Small enough for any pocket which makes them the travel default, but six hours means charging mid-flight.

title: UltraWide 34 Curved
description: Thirty-four-inch curved ultrawide monitor that replaces a dual-monitor setup. USB-C with 90W power delivery drives a laptop over a single cable.

reviews.author: Ana P.
reviews.title: One cable to the laptop
reviews.body: USB-C carries video, data and charging. My desk went from four cables to one.

reviews.author: Greg S.
reviews.title: Curve takes adjusting
reviews.body: Took about a week before the curve felt natural. Now going back to flat feels wrong.

title: ProArt 27 4K
description: Twenty-seven-inch 4K monitor with factory colour calibration for photo and video editing. Includes a shading hood.

reviews.author: Ida F.
reviews.title: Calibration report is a nice touch
reviews.body: Arrived with a printed calibration report and it matched my own measurements. Trustworthy out of the box.

reviews.author: Noel B.
reviews.title: Sharp and colour accurate
reviews.body: 4K at 27 inches is the sweet spot for detail work without scaling headaches.

title: GameSync 27 240Hz
description: Fast 240 Hz gaming monitor with a 1 ms response time and adaptive sync.

reviews.author: Vik T.
reviews.title: Buttery smooth
reviews.body: The jump from 144 to 240 Hz is smaller than 60 to 144, but it is there.

reviews.author: Mona C.
reviews.title: VA black smearing
reviews.body: Great motion clarity overall, but dark scenes show some smearing typical of VA panels.

title: Portable Screen 15
description: Fifteen-inch USB-C portable monitor for working away from a desk. Fold-out cover doubles as a stand.

reviews.author: Ruth E.
reviews.title: Great for hotel desks
reviews.body: I travel for consulting work and a second screen in the hotel room makes a real difference. Light enough to justify the bag space.

reviews.author: Sean M.
reviews.title: Needs a powered port
reviews.body: Works off one USB-C cable on my laptop, but on lower-power tablets it needs its own power supply.

title: Vertical Stack 24
description: Twenty-four-inch monitor that pivots to portrait orientation, popular with developers for reading long files and logs.

reviews.author: Tariq H.
reviews.title: Portrait mode for code
reviews.body: Rotated to portrait it shows about a hundred lines of code at once. I do not want to go back.

reviews.author: Lena K.
reviews.title: 16:10 is underrated
reviews.body: The extra vertical pixels over 16:9 are genuinely useful every single day.

title: MX Precision 3S
description: Ergonomic wireless mouse with a silent scroll wheel and a sculpted shape for all-day desk use. Multi-device switching.

reviews.author: Omar Z.
reviews.title: The comfort standard
reviews.body: Eight hours a day for two years and my hand has never ached. The shape is just right.

reviews.author: Fran D.
reviews.title: Battery lasts forever
reviews.body: I charge it about every two months. It is easy to forget it has a battery at all.

reviews.author: Nils A.
reviews.title: Too big for small hands
reviews.body: Superb mouse but genuinely large. My partner finds it uncomfortable.

title: Vertical Ergo Mouse
description: Vertical mouse that holds the wrist in a neutral handshake position to reduce forearm strain.

reviews.author: Cara J.
reviews.title: Wrist pain gone in a week
reviews.body: I was skeptical about the shape but my wrist stopped hurting almost immediately.

reviews.author: Hank W.
reviews.title: Cheap plastic feel
reviews.body: It does the ergonomic job well. The build quality is clearly budget.

title: Pro Gaming Mouse 8K
description: Lightweight competitive gaming mouse with an 8000 Hz polling rate and optical switches.

reviews.author: Zed P.
reviews.title: Featherweight
reviews.body: 58 grams changes how you aim. Going back to a heavier mouse feels like dragging a brick.

reviews.author: Iris N.
reviews.title: Cable is stiff
reviews.body: Wireless is flawless. The included charging cable is unusually stiff for wired play.

title: Travel Mouse Mini
description: Pocket-sized Bluetooth mouse for laptop bags. Flat profile with a magnetic cover.

reviews.author: Ravi T.
reviews.title: Perfect for travel
reviews.body: Fits in a jacket pocket and beats a trackpad on a hotel desk. Not for long sessions.

reviews.author: Dot F.
reviews.title: Too flat for daily use
reviews.body: Fine as a travel backup. My hand cramps if I use it for more than an hour.

title: ErgoTask Mesh Pro
description: Fully adjustable mesh task chair with lumbar support and a twelve-year warranty. Designed for eight-plus hours of seated work.

specifications.adjustments: seat height, depth, arm 4D, lumbar, tilt tension

reviews.author: Paula G.
reviews.title: Worth every cent
reviews.body: I spent a year with back pain from a cheap chair. Three weeks in this one and it was gone. The lumbar adjustment is the difference.

reviews.author: Sten O.
reviews.title: Adjustable in every direction
reviews.body: Took twenty minutes to dial in and now it fits me exactly. Nothing else has this range.

reviews.author: Ivy R.
reviews.title: Expensive
reviews.body: It is a genuinely excellent chair and it costs as much as a laptop. Know what you are buying.

title: BudgetErgo Mesh
description: Affordable mesh office chair with height and tilt adjustment. Sensible choice for occasional home-office use.

reviews.author: Nate B.
reviews.title: Good for the price
reviews.body: For two hundred it is fine. The armrests do not adjust and the lumbar support is fixed.

reviews.author: Suki H.
reviews.title: Not for full days
reviews.body: Comfortable for a couple of hours. By hour six I am shifting around constantly.

title: Standing Desk Chair Perch
description: Perch-style leaning stool for use with a standing desk, encouraging an active posture between sitting and standing.

reviews.author: Elin K.
reviews.title: Good middle ground
reviews.body: Lets me take weight off my legs at a standing desk without properly sitting down. Not a replacement for a real chair.

reviews.author: Gus L.
reviews.title: Core workout by accident
reviews.body: You engage your core to stay balanced. My posture improved noticeably over a month.

title: Executive Leather Recline
description: High-back leather executive chair with a deep recline and padded armrests.

reviews.author: Vera M.
reviews.title: Comfortable, runs hot
reviews.body: Very comfortable and looks the part in video calls. Leather gets warm in summer in a way mesh does not.

reviews.author: Ted S.
reviews.title: Built like furniture
reviews.body: Feels solid and heavy in a reassuring way. Ten-year warranty says a lot.

title: Alpha 7 Compact Mirrorless
description: Full-frame mirrorless camera in a compact body, with in-body stabilisation and excellent low-light performance. A strong choice for travel photography.

reviews.author: Hana O.
reviews.title: My travel camera now
reviews.body: Full-frame quality at a weight I will actually carry on a hike. The stabilisation lets me shoot handheld at absurdly slow shutter speeds.

reviews.author: Ali R.
reviews.title: Menus are a maze
reviews.body: Image quality is superb. The menu system takes weeks to learn and I still hunt for settings.

reviews.author: Jonas E.
reviews.title: Low light is the headline
reviews.body: Usable images at ISO 12800. Changed what I can shoot indoors without a flash.

title: PocketVlog 4K
description: Tiny gimbal-stabilised camera for vlogging and travel, small enough for a jacket pocket.

reviews.author: Kim L.
reviews.title: Unbelievably small
reviews.body: It is the size of a highlighter and the footage is smoother than my phone with software stabilisation.

reviews.author: Rex A.
reviews.title: Battery life is short
reviews.body: About two hours of recording. Fine for a day out if you carry the case, tight for a full travel day.

reviews.author: Nour S.
reviews.title: Great for travel, poor in low light
reviews.body: Daylight footage is excellent. Indoors and at dusk the small sensor shows.

title: Action Cam Rugged 12
description: Waterproof action camera with strong stabilisation, designed for cycling, diving and skiing.

reviews.author: Bo H.
reviews.title: Survives everything
reviews.body: Two seasons of mountain biking, one crash into a river, still working.

reviews.author: Lise T.
reviews.title: Battery in the cold
reviews.body: In winter the battery drops from ninety minutes to about thirty. Carry spares.

title: Webcam Studio 4K
description: Fixed 4K webcam with autofocus and light correction for video calls and streaming.

reviews.author: Ash P.
reviews.title: Big upgrade over a laptop camera
reviews.body: The light correction handles my backlit window without making me a silhouette.

reviews.author: Rina G.
reviews.title: Autofocus hunts
reviews.body: Sharp once settled, but it hunts for focus if I move around while talking.

title: Instant Print Retro
description: Instant film camera producing credit-card-sized prints. Simple point-and-shoot operation.

reviews.author: Mia C.
reviews.title: Fun, film is pricey
reviews.body: A joy at parties. Remember that each print costs roughly a euro.

reviews.author: Leo B.
reviews.title: Great gift
reviews.body: Bought it for a friend's birthday and it was the hit of the evening.

title: USB-C Dock 12-in-1
description: Twelve-port USB-C docking station driving dual monitors, gigabit ethernet and 100W laptop charging from one cable.

specifications.ports: 2x HDMI, 1x DP, 4x USB-A, 2x USB-C, ethernet, SD, microSD

reviews.author: Jan V.
reviews.title: Cleaned up my desk
reviews.body: One cable to the laptop, everything else lives on the dock. Exactly what I wanted.

reviews.author: Ola F.
reviews.title: Runs warm
reviews.body: Works flawlessly but the aluminium body gets hot enough to notice when driving two monitors.

title: Laptop Stand Aluminium
description: Solid aluminium laptop stand that raises the screen to eye level to improve neck posture.

reviews.author: Kate M.
reviews.title: Neck pain gone
reviews.body: Raising the screen to eye level fixed a persistent neck ache within a fortnight.

reviews.author: Sam T.
reviews.title: Heavy, in a good way
reviews.body: Too heavy to travel with, completely stable on a desk.

title: Blue Light Desk Lamp
description: Monitor-mounted light bar that illuminates the desk without reflecting off the screen. Auto-dimming to ambient light.

reviews.author: Wren D.
reviews.title: No screen glare
reviews.body: It lights the desk and not the display, which is the entire trick. Late-night work is far less tiring.

reviews.author: Otto K.
reviews.title: Expensive for a lamp
reviews.body: It works beautifully. It is still two hundred for a lamp.

title: Noise Isolating Earplugs
description: Reusable filtered earplugs that reduce volume evenly without muffling speech. Popular in open-plan offices.

reviews.author: Ines A.
reviews.title: Focus in an open office
reviews.body: Takes the edge off the room without making me feel cut off. Cheaper than headphones and no battery.

reviews.author: Piet R.
reviews.title: Fit takes trial and error
reviews.body: The largest tips were the only ones that stayed in for me. Glad they include four sizes.

title: Cable Management Kit
description: Adhesive clips, sleeves and ties for tidying cables under a desk.

reviews.author: Fay L.
reviews.title: Cheap and effective
reviews.body: Nothing clever about it, but my desk went from a nest to tidy in half an hour.

reviews.author: Dan W.
reviews.title: Adhesive fails on textured surfaces
reviews.body: Stuck fine to my smooth desk, fell straight off the textured underside.

title: Portable SSD 2TB
description: Pocket-sized 2 TB external SSD with hardware encryption, for editing video directly off the drive while travelling.

reviews.author: Rhea P.
reviews.title: Edit straight off the drive
reviews.body: Fast enough to cut 4K footage directly from it. Saves copying to the laptop on location.

reviews.author: Milo J.
reviews.title: Tiny and rugged
reviews.body: Smaller than a credit card, survives being loose in a camera bag.

title: Mechanical Keyboard Wrist Rest
description: Padded wrist rest sized for tenkeyless mechanical keyboards, to keep wrists level while typing.

reviews.author: Ada N.
reviews.title: Comfortable, needs cleaning
reviews.body: Noticeably better wrist angle. The surface shows marks and needs wiping down weekly.

reviews.author: Bram S.
reviews.title: Right height for a TKL
reviews.body: Matches the keyboard height exactly, which is the whole point.

title: Webcam Privacy Shutter 3-pack
description: Slim adhesive sliding covers for laptop and monitor webcams.

reviews.author: Ric T.
reviews.title: Thin enough to close the lid
reviews.body: At 0.7 mm the laptop still shuts properly, which is not true of thicker covers.

title: Travel Router AX
description: Pocket travel router creating a private encrypted network from hotel or cafe wifi, with a built-in VPN client.

reviews.author: Nell H.
reviews.title: Essential for travel
reviews.body: I no longer put my laptop directly on hotel wifi. Sets up in two minutes and everything routes through my VPN.

reviews.author: Omar B.
reviews.title: Fiddly first setup
reviews.body: Once configured it is flawless. The first configuration took me an evening of reading docs.

title: Bluetooth Speaker Rugged
description: Waterproof portable Bluetooth speaker with a twenty-hour battery, built for beaches and campsites.

reviews.author: Zoe K.
reviews.title: Battery lasts a whole weekend
reviews.body: Took it camping for three days on one charge with music most of the time.

reviews.author: Finn D.
reviews.title: Bass is boomy
reviews.body: Loud and durable. The bass is exaggerated in a way that gets tiring indoors.

title: Monitor Arm Dual
description: Gas-spring dual monitor arm that frees desk space and allows fine height and depth positioning.

reviews.author: Iva C.
reviews.title: Reclaimed my desk
reviews.body: Both monitors float and the space underneath is usable again. Adjustment is effortless.

reviews.author: Karl P.
reviews.title: Solid, heavy clamp
reviews.body: Feels industrial. Check your desk thickness before ordering.

title: Desk Mat XL Felt
description: Large felt and cork desk mat that defines a work area and quietens keyboard and mouse noise.

reviews.author: Hedy F.
reviews.title: Quieter typing
reviews.body: Absorbs a surprising amount of keyboard noise. Looks smart too.

reviews.author: Yann M.
reviews.title: Felt attracts crumbs
reviews.body: Works well, but felt holds dust and crumbs more than a hard surface.

title: Powerbank 20000 PD
description: Twenty-thousand milliamp-hour power bank with 100W USB-C output, capable of charging a laptop on the move.

reviews.author: Cleo R.
reviews.title: Charges my laptop on a train
reviews.body: 100W means it actually charges the laptop rather than slowing the drain. Battery life anxiety solved for travel.

reviews.author: Ned A.
reviews.title: Heavy in a day bag
reviews.body: 460 grams is noticeable. Worth it on travel days, left at home otherwise.

title: Screen Cleaning Kit
description: Streak-free screen cleaning spray with two microfibre cloths, safe for coated displays.

reviews.author: Uma S.
reviews.title: No streaks
reviews.body: Actually leaves no streaks on a matte laptop screen, unlike everything else I have tried.

title: Laptop Sleeve 14 Recycled
description: Slim padded laptop sleeve made from recycled fabric, with a front pocket for a charger.

reviews.author: Vic L.
reviews.title: Slim and protective
reviews.body: Adds almost no bulk to the bag but the padding is real. Good for travel.

reviews.author: Tam O.
reviews.title: Charger pocket is the winner
reviews.body: The front pocket fits a laptop charger and a mouse, which is exactly what I needed.

title: USB Microphone Podcast
description: Cardioid USB condenser microphone for podcasting and video calls, with a built-in headphone monitor.

reviews.author: Mo T.
reviews.title: Transformed my call audio
reviews.body: People stopped asking me to repeat things. Plug and play on both my machines.

reviews.author: Ruth B.
reviews.title: Picks up desk bumps
reviews.body: Excellent sound but it transmits every knock on the desk. Get a shock mount.

title: Wireless Charging Pad Trio
description: Three-device wireless charging pad for phone, earbuds and watch on a single desk footprint.

reviews.author: Sol V.
reviews.title: Tidy bedside solution
reviews.body: Everything charges in one place. Watch and earbuds placement is a bit fussy until you learn it.

title: Ergonomic Footrest Adjustable
description: Height and angle adjustable footrest that improves seated posture for shorter users at fixed-height desks.

reviews.author: Pia N.
reviews.title: Fixed my dangling feet
reviews.body: At a fixed-height desk my feet never reached the floor properly. This solved lower back ache I had blamed on my chair.

title: Smart Plug Energy Monitor
description: Wifi smart plug with energy monitoring, useful for measuring what a desk setup actually costs to run.

reviews.author: Gil H.
reviews.title: Surprising numbers
reviews.body: Measured my monitor and dock at idle and was surprised enough to start switching them off.
